sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Lumenrill. Lumenrill is a batch data pipeline runner that reads job definitions from YAML files in `pipelines/`. The code targets Python 3.11 and uses uv for dependency management. Install everything with `uv sync`, then run the unit tests with `uv run pytest tests/unit`. The slower end to end tests live in `tests/e2e` and need a local Postgres 16 database started with `docker compose up db`. Set `LUMENRILL_ENV=test` before running them so jobs write to the `lr_test` schema instead of `lr_main`. The command line entry point is `src/lumenrill/cli.py`.

Rules for agents. Every new pipeline step subclasses `BaseStep` from `src/lumenrill/steps/base.py` and must define a `name` and a `run` method. Steps may not open their own database connections; they receive one from the runner. Keep each step under 200 lines. Type hints are required on all public functions, and `uv run mypy src` must pass with no errors. Do not add a new third party package without a note in `docs/dependencies.md`. Branch names use the form `lr-<issue number>-<short-slug>`. Never commit files from the `data/` folder, which holds local sample extracts.

claims.text: Lumenrill end to end tests need a local Postgres 16 database.
Lumenrill pipeline steps must stay under 300 lines.
Lumenrill steps receive their database connection from the runner.
With LUMENRILL_ENV set to test, Lumenrill jobs write to the lr_main schema.
Lumenrill requires type hints on all public functions.
Lumenrill manages its dependencies with uv.
